svg.text: Zero to many projects. Activities are grouped by their
Zero to many per project. The ready ones are offered
first; nothing forces one at a time.
Chores is never picked. It joins the day on its own while it
carries work that is not done.
Archived projects and paused routines are not offered. A
ready activity is one with no unfinished predecessor. Any
date is focusable: a past day, today or a future day.
A commit replaces the date's previous selection rather
than adding to it, so the boards in play are exactly what
was last committed. A routine that already owes a task
gets no second one, on any date. Due and overdue are
treated the same. Dropping a routine leaves a task
